scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir "${DMS_FRONTEND_WORKSPACE:?Set DMS_FRONTEND_WORKSPACE to the generated Inertia workspace}" typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm -s run types && eslint . && node --input-type=module -e "import { assertApiErrorPresentation } from '@antelopejs/dms/checks/api-error-presentation'; import { assertDmsComponents } from '@antelopejs/dms/checks/dms-components'; assertApiErrorPresentation(['app']); await assertDmsComponents({ layer: '.', sources: ['../src'] });"
scripts.types: pnpm --dir .. exec ajs dms prepare-types -q --layer node_modules/@antelopejs/dms/frontend-vue --module frontend-vue --out frontend-vue/.dms-types
